q1_assessment.why: Only R6 is an unconditional STRONG cell. R2 is significant but d=-0.099; R5b dies under a tuned baseline; R5c is smoke-only and the production checkpoint flips to baseline-wins (+10.37%); R1's win is init-attributed and its pooled effect fell from +0.1609 to +0.1178 at NFE=150. The namesake restart-blend still has no clean positive cell.
q1_assessment.decisive_missing_piece: One pre-registered, power-calibrated positive cell for the restart-blend, against a tuned baseline with Bonferroni control. GAP-43 pre-registers R3 fg_dev with the faithful all-channel blend + shared prior (a combination never run), 50 fresh seeds (55, 65, ..., 545; step 10 so solver-seed blocks are disjoint), alpha=0.05/7, |d|>=0.5, plus a 10-seed baseline-NFE=1000 tuned gate. n=50 is the smallest n that powers the 0.5 floor at 80%.
q1_assessment.if_met: Q1-defensible: R6 + K4/K5 + cross-domain breadth + Tier-1 reproducibility infrastructure.
q1_assessment.if_not_met: Major revision at best; reject risk if the blend still has no positive cell.

metric_remediation.current: PARTIAL: d=+0.1178 at NFE=150 (n=3); +0.1609 at NFE=10; init-attributed
metric_remediation.blocker: No blend-off arm at the canonical NFE=150 budget. GAP-25 isolated the blend at NFE=10 and got an approximately zero point estimate with an upper bound of +46 hits, so the observed R1 win cannot be credited to the namesake blend. Note the convention: the adapter blend is m*prior + (1-m)*fresh with m = 1 - beta, so a true blend-off (identity restart) is beta = 0 / m = 1, NOT m = 0. GATE FINDING (2026-10-18): the GAP-25/D-004b framework manifests record nfe_per_record=10 with restart_min_nfe=20, and the driver downgrades n_rounds to 1 below that threshold, so the 'blend' arm never ran apply_restart_distribution in a feeding round. B~C is therefore not evidence that the blend is zero; the blend has not been tested at any budget.
metric_remediation.plan: GAP-45-R1-BLEND-OFF-150: paired blend-on vs blend-off at NFE=150, N=200 x 3 seeds, canonical HMMER counter. Blend-off arm = `--beta-override 0.0` (m = 1, identity restart); blend-on arm = the canonical default (beta = 0.5 * 50/150 = 0.1667 at NFE=150).
metric_remediation.acceptance: Delta(blend_on - blend_off) with a 95% CI. CI excludes 0 in the positive direction -> the blend gets a second positive cell; CI includes 0 -> R1 stays init-attributed and PARTIAL.
metric_remediation.cost: ~8-9 h CPU (6 arms x ~81 min at N=200 + HMMER)

open_gaps.gap: The namesake restart-blend has no clean positive cell. A review of the pilots found two design defects: (i) GAP-39's blend run used the legacy arm-keyed prior (shared_prior=false), so its d_z is measured under the pairing defect GAP-37 fixed; (ii) GAP-39's 'K1' endpoint is paper_pb_validity_pct (UFF PoseBusters pb_valid), not the canonical rdkit_validity_pct (saturated at 1.0). The decisive test is therefore R3 fg_dev with the faithful all-channel blend + shared prior, a combination never run. Candidate B (R6 hard-tier) is not a blend cell and is a breadth fallback only.
open_gaps.acceptance: Pre-registration committed BEFORE the run: docs/audit/gap43-blend-positive-preregistration.md. R3 fg_dev, real blend (memory 0.5), shared prior, fresh seeds 55, 65, ..., 545 (step 10), n=50, N=1000/arm, alpha=0.05/7, |d_z|>=0.5. Positive = mean<0 AND p<0.0071429 AND |d_z|>=0.5 AND the tuned-baseline gate passes (mean delta_tuned<0 on seeds 55, 65, ..., 145, baseline NFE=1000, best-of per seed). Bounded negative = d_z bootstrap CI lower bound > -0.5. Otherwise inconclusive; only a fresh-seed extension is permitted.
